verdict.rationale: Unity's docs generically reference 'scalable, captivating visuals using the latest advances in rendering, lighting, and visual effects' but the evidence pack lacks specific documentation of PBR material workflows, GI/baked lighting systems (e.g. Enlighten, GI/Lightmapping), shadow systems, or the post-processing stack/URP/HDRP pipelines by name. Missing for 10: explicit PBR shader/material docs, named GI/lightmapping system details, shadow-mapping specifics, post-processing stack documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of renderer quality.
